summary: BioVie Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 14, 2026 (event date September 11, 2026) reporting entry into an at-the-market sales agreement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners. The company may sell up to $6,464,341 of Class A common stock under its effective Form S-3 shelf (File No. 333-296924, declared effective June 29, 2026). The agent receives a 3.0% commission on gross proceeds and expense reimbursement; proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is a routine shelf takedown facility, not a special situation, though the ATM overhang and ongoing dilution warrant monitoring.
